items.task: Source session for the next release (core-v0.9), about two hours. Read tracks/core/NEXT_SOURCE.md first (the core lead's list of 2026-11-26 with files, lines and tests: dep_levels.py, diag_restart.py) and Track A's request to core on the finder (git show track/A-emd-pbh:tracks/A-emd-pbh/outbox/ and look for finder-slow-convergence-box and finder-false-accept-and-stall-p0l6; decision 0047 item 6 summarises what Track A measured). Work in this order and close what you start; if time runs short stop after an item and say so. (0) `deposit_fine_shape` with the CIC cloud is not inert at a level face that is not capped: a dipole of +-0.125 in the fine cells (athenak/src/particles/nrpic.cpp near lines 993 to 1072). (0b) The compensation pass is not conservative across a level face (with Track A's settings, pcs_comp, a line sum of 32.0413 instead of 32). (1) A run continued from a restart file accepts parameters that are not in the input stored in that file, from the command line as from an input file, with a line in the log, so that <fastflow> diagnostics and the new finder options can be switched on in a chain (Tracks D and F). (2) The horizon finder in periodic boxes (Track A's gate G2 failed partly on it): from the deck's start radius the flow does not converge within the cap of iterations while tracked shells are trapped (the periodic chain is found with 4000 iterations, the triaxial run only from a start near the trapped radius), and once a surface was accepted that is not trapped. Say from the source what limits the convergence; add, off by default, a start radius taken from a scan of round spheres for the outermost trapped one, and a check before 'found' is reported that the accepted surface is trapped to a stated tolerance; test on the restart files Track A names (processors; the release build reads them). Items 0 and 0b change the deposit at level faces without an option: list them in the changelog as changes without an option and say which kinds of runs change (refined meshes with compensation or with deposit_fine_shape) and which of the 75 items of the byte regression may differ and why; everything else stays byte-identical to .work/build_cpu_v08. Tests with predictions first, on processors. Card build and ONE card check through the shared queue at priority 2. Publish the executables under a NEW directory scratch/core/exe/<branch>/ with COMMIT, SHA256SUMS and READY. Interface text as proposals under tracks/core/interfaces/. Tell Tracks A, D and F (outbox) what changes for them and which executable to use for retests (Track A retests its constraint floor on it: decision 0047 item 2(a)).
